definitions.explanation: Thirty persons, formed with the counter {人|にん}. From {四人|よにん} upward the counter is regularly {にん}, so no sound change occurs here.

examples.japanese: クラスは{三十人|さんじゅうにん}だ。
{約|やく}{三十人|さんじゅうにん}が{会議|かいぎ}に{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: About thirty people took part in the meeting.

examples.japanese: {定員|ていいん}は{三十人|さんじゅうにん}なので、{申|もう}し{込|こ}みが{多|おお}い{場合|ばあい}は{抽選|ちゅうせん}になります。
examples.english: Capacity is thirty people, so if there are many applications there will be a lottery.

notes:
{三十|さんじゅう} (thirty) + the counter {人|にん}. Only the first three counts are irregular; everything from four upward simply adds {にん}.

COUNTING PEOPLE:
- {一人|ひとり}: one person — irregular
- {二人|ふたり}: two people — irregular
- {三人|さんにん}: three people
- {四人|よにん}: four people — {よん} shortens to {よ}
- {三十人|さんじゅうにん}: thirty people

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {三十人|さんじゅうにん}{学級|がっきゅう}: a class of thirty, a common benchmark in Japanese education policy
- {定員|ていいん}{三十人|さんじゅうにん}: capacity of thirty
- {三十人|さんじゅうにん}{程度|ていど}: around thirty people
